description: This file is the core module of Chart.js, defining chart types, controllers, default settings, and rendering logic for various chart types including bar, line, pie, doughnut, bubble, and more. It sets up the structure and behavior of charts used in the library.

classes.name: Chart.controllers.bar
classes.description: Controller for bar charts, managing bar rendering, positioning, and stacking.

classes.name: Chart.controllers.bubble
classes.description: Controller for bubble charts, managing point elements representing bubbles.

classes.name: Chart.controllers.doughnut
classes.description: Controller for doughnut (pie slice) charts, managing arc elements and segments.

classes.name: Chart.DatasetController
classes.description: Base class for all dataset controllers (line, bar, etc) responsible for managing dataset elements within a chart, including their creation, updating, removal, and interaction handling.

classes.name: Scale
classes.description: Base class for different scale types in charting, providing core methods for data range calculation, tick generation, and value conversions.

classes.name: LinearScale
classes.description: Implements linear scaling for numerical data, including tick calculation and pixel conversions.

classes.name: LogarithmicScale
classes.description: Implements logarithmic scaling with appropriate tick generation and data limits handling.

classes.name: TimeScale
classes.description: Handles time-based scaling, generating ticks based on date/time intervals.

classes.name: RadialLinearScale
classes.description: Specialized scale for radar/spider charts, handling angular and radial data representation.

classes.name: TimeScale
classes.description: Handles time-based scaling, generating ticks based on date/time intervals, managing data limits, and converting time values to pixel positions.

methods.name: Chart.prototype.update
methods.description: Main update loop that renders all chart elements based on current data and configuration.

methods.name: Chart.controllers.bar.updateElement
methods.description: Updates the properties of individual bar elements during rendering, including position and size.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the dataset controller with the chart instance and dataset index, links scales, and adds elements.

methods.name: updateIndex
methods.description: Updates the dataset index of the controller.

methods.name: linkScales
methods.description: Links the dataset to the appropriate x and y scales based on dataset configuration and chart options.

methods.name: getDataset
methods.description: Returns the dataset object for the current dataset index.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves the metadata for the dataset, including elements.

methods.name: getScaleForId
methods.description: Returns the scale object corresponding to the provided scale ID.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the dataset elements by updating their properties.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from data array events when the controller is destroyed.

methods.name: createMetaDataset
methods.description: Creates the meta dataset element (e.g., a line element for line charts).

methods.name: createMetaData
methods.description: Creates a meta data element (e.g., Point for line, bar for bar charts) for a specific data index.

methods.name: addElements
methods.description: Adds meta data elements for each data point and the dataset element.

methods.name: addElementAndReset
methods.description: Creates and adds a new data element at the specified index, then resets its properties.

methods.name: buildOrUpdateElements
methods.description: Ensures internal data aligns with dataset data, listening to array events for real-time updates.

methods.name: update
methods.description: A placeholder method to be overridden, responsible for updating element properties; no-op here.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Handles the transition of elements between states with easing value.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws all dataset elements and dataset meta element onto the canvas.

methods.name: removeHoverStyle
methods.description: Restores the element's style from previous hover state.

methods.name: setHoverStyle
methods.description: Sets hover style on an element based on dataset hover options.

methods.name: resyncElements
methods.description: Re-synchronizes the internal meta data array with the dataset data array, adding or removing elements as needed.

methods.name: insertElements
methods.description: Inserts new elements at specified position, creating them and resetting their properties.

methods.name: onDataPush
methods.description: Handles appending new data points to the dataset, inserting new elements accordingly.

methods.name: onDataPop
methods.description: Removes the last element when data array pops.

methods.name: onDataShift
methods.description: Removes the first element when data array shifts.

methods.name: onDataSplice
methods.description: Handles deleting and inserting multiple data points at a specific start index.

methods.name: onDataUnshift
methods.description: Handles prepending data points to the dataset.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the entire canvas associated with the provided chart.

methods.name: roundedRect
methods.description: Creates a path for a rectangle with rounded corners given a position, size, and radius.

methods.name: drawPoint
methods.description: Draws various point styles (circle, triangle, rect, star, line, dash, image) on the canvas at specified coordinates.

methods.name: clipArea
methods.description: Creates a clipping region for the canvas based on the specified rectangular area.

methods.name: unclipArea
methods.description: Restores the canvas to remove the current clipping region.

methods.name: lineTo
methods.description: Draws a line or bezier curve between points, supporting stepped, tension, and flip options.

methods.name: determineDataLimits
methods.description: Calculates minimum and maximum data values based on datasets and scale configuration.

methods.name: buildTicks
methods.description: Generates tick values for the scale based on data limits and user options.

methods.name: getPixelForValue
methods.description: Converts a data value to its corresponding pixel position on the chart.

methods.name: getValueForPixel
methods.description: Converts a pixel position back to the corresponding data value.

methods.name: convertTicksToLabels
methods.description: Converts tick values into display labels for axes.

methods.name: handleTickRangeOptions
methods.description: Adjusts data limits based on tick configuration options like min, max, beginAtZero.

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Calculates the optimal size of the scale based on label sizes and scale options.

methods.name: setCenterPoint
methods.description: Determines the center point for radial/Polar scales based on the computed radius reductions.

methods.name: getPixelForValue
methods.description: Converts a data value (possibly time) to its corresponding pixel position on the chart.

methods.name: getValueForPixel
methods.description: Converts a pixel position back to the corresponding data value (time).

methods.name: convertTicksToLabels
methods.description: Converts tick values into display labels for axes, formatting with moment.js.
